cim: GITEX Global 2026 to showcase advancements in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity
cim_eredeti: GITEX Global 2026 to showcase advancements in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity
szoveg_eredeti:
GITEX Global 2026 is scheduled to return for its 46th edition in Dubai, bringing together thousands of industry leaders to discuss the latest developments in technology and digital infrastructure, based on information published by Biometric Update.

The event will take place from Dec. 7 to 11, 2026, and is expected to host more than 200,000 tech executives from 180 countries. Participants include 6,800 exhibiting companies, 2,000 startups, and 400 government entities. The summit begins with an invite-only session on Dec. 7 at the Dubai World Trade Centre, followed by the main exhibition at the Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City Dubai.

The conference will feature specialized tracks covering artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centers, quantum technology, mobility, robotics, and cybersecurity. By facilitating connections between industry leaders and government representatives, the event aims to accelerate business growth and foster international partnerships. Attendees will have the opportunity to explore emerging solutions in agentic AI and energy technology, reflecting the rapid evolution of the global digital landscape. This gathering serves as a critical platform for addressing modern security challenges and technological integration across various sectors.

prioritas.indok: Esemény- és konferenciapromóció, amely nem tartalmaz érdemi technológiai hírt.
prioritas.cim_hu: Dubaiban rendezik meg a GITEX Global 2026 technológiai konferenciát
prioritas.lead_hu: Ismét Dubaiban tartják a GITEX Global rendezvényt, ahol a technológiai szektor és a digitális infrastruktúra vezetői találkoznak. A konferencián a mesterséges intelligencia és a kiberbiztonság is kiemelt téma lesz.
